subject: FundWave priority commitment request
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: FundWave priority commitment request

Team —

Quick background: FundWave is at contract signature conditional on two items we currently don't expose as first-class features: tenant-level encryption toggle (customer needs the ability to disable persistent KV caching and require encrypted-at-rest with a configurable retention window) and an extended audit-retention option (they need 2 years of request-level audit logs). Legal and Security on their side are firm on both before signing.

They've signaled willingness to move to a 6-month dedicated capacity commit if we can deliver a pilot with these controls in ~6 weeks. That would be a high-velocity expansion opportunity for Q1. I attached a short scope spreadsheet and the draft SLA they expect.

Asks:
- Product: can we scope a minimally viable workplan that satisfies their compliance bar for pilot (toggle + retention extension), and commit an ETA?
- Engineering: high-level feasibility and a rough dev-week estimate (phase split if helpful).
- Sales: I'll need a firm recommendation to include in the commitment letter to FundWave; if we need concessions we should flag them now.

If we can commit Phase A (pilot) within 6w I will push to close this week and offer a tangible uplift in contract (6mo reserved) that covers some dedicated eng support. If not, we need a fallback we can live with.

Proposed meeting: today 3pm PT — 30m triage.

Thanks,
Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: FundWave_MVP_scope.xlsx, SLA_commitment_draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FundWave priority commitment request

Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the doc. High level: product is willing to support a two-phase approach so we can get the pilot live quickly and buy time to harden the longer-term pieces. My initial thoughts:

Phase A (pilot, target 4–6w):
- Expose a config toggle to disable persistent KV caching for a tenant and a retention override for audit logs (server-side setting + admin API).
- Surface a clear documented limitation (no CMK rotation, no HSM integration in Phase A).

Phase B (post-sign, 8–12w):
- CMK integration, rotation, stronger attestation, plus an audit pipeline for long-term immutable retention.

What I need from Eng to finalize scoping: estimated dev-weeks for both phases and any blockers. From Sales: what specific language does FundWave need in the SLA around retention and proof of deletion/exports? Put any non-negotiable terms in the doc so we can minimize legal churn.

If Phase A is feasible on that timeline, I can carve this into the 6w sprint roadmap as a focused P0.

-Marissa
Director, Product Management | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-04T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FundWave priority commitment request

Karthik / Marissa —

Technical read: we can do Phase A as described but there are non-trivial safety and cost tradeoffs. Short summary:

- Tenant toggle + retention override: low-to-medium complexity. We can gate persistent KV cache access per-tenant and add an admin API flag to extend audit-retention. Estimate: 3 engineer-weeks to implement core toggle + admin UI + retention field, 1 week testing + staging validation (4w end-to-end), assuming no refactors.

- CMK + rotation + immutable audit pipeline (Phase B): medium-high complexity. Requires KMS integration (cloud KMS API), key lifecycle hooks, and a storage pipeline for immutable logs. Estimate: 6–8 engineer-weeks plus infra work and extra security review (6–8w).

Risks / notes:
- Disabling persistent KV caching has a performance cost; we should document expected latency/cost delta for the pilot (approx +8–15% token cost depending on workload).
- Long-term CC requirements (HSM-backed keys, attestation) will add time and likely require a separate compliance review.

Workaround if we can't commit Phase A on time: we can ship a managed proxy for FundWave that handles audit exports and enforces retention externally for the pilot, but that's operationally heavier and not ideal long-term.

I've attached a quick sketch of the implementation flow (implementation_sketch.png) and created a Jira epic to track this: ENG-4319. If Product confirms priority, we can scope a minimal ticket set and target inclusion in the sprint starting 2026-12-13.

Cheers,
Soojin
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Aligning on next steps:

1) Marissa: please put Phase A (toggle + retention override) into the 12/13 sprint intake as P0 with Soojin's rough estimates. If you need a formal JIRA scope I can shepherd the stories with you.
2) Soojin: can you confirm the 4w Phase A estimate in ENG-4319 and add a short tech note on expected perf/cost delta? That will be part of the commitment letter.
3) Ben / Monica (Sales/CS): I will tell FundWave we can deliver a pilot in ~6 weeks with the noted limitations and that Phase B is a separate follow-on. I will also include a provisional commercial incentive: 6-month reserved capacity at an uplift that covers dedicated eng support for the first 2 months.

If Product/Eng can formally commit Phase A by EOD tomorrow I will proceed to confirm with FundWave and push for signature. If not, please call out the blocker now so we can decide whether to offer the managed-proxy fallback.

I booked the 3pm PT triage for today; if you can't make it, post notes in the HubSpot thread and I'll capture decisions.

Thanks — pushing to close this week,
Karthik
